gen_risks.mitigation: Establish a stakeholder engagement plan, ensure inclusive and participatory processes, and provide training on ethical data security protocols

gen_risks.description: Delays, governance issues, weak contract management, and limited market competition in fragile settings
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement a financial management system, ensure transparency and accountability, and provide training on contract management and procurement

gen_risks.description: Potential delays in implementation due to political instability, security risks, and governance challenges
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a detailed implementation schedule, ensure regular monitoring and reporting, and provide training on project management and coordination

gen_risks.description: Inadequate engagement with local communities, civil society organizations, and other stakeholders
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish a stakeholder engagement plan, ensure inclusive and participatory processes, and provide training on community engagement and participation

gen_risks.description: Changes in government policies, laws, or regulations that may affect the project's implementation
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish a regulatory framework, ensure compliance with laws and regulations, and provide training on policy and regulatory issues

gen_risks.description: Impacts on water quality, disposal and management of building/construction wastes, occupational health and safety risks, and nuisances related to air and noise emissions
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement an environmental management plan, ensure compliance with environmental regulations, and provide training on environmental management and sustainability

gen_risks.description: Inadequate institutional capacity, weak governance, and insufficient human resources
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish an institutional capacity building plan, ensure adequate human resources, and provide training on governance, management, and leadership

gen_risks.description: Climate change, conflicts, and other external factors that may affect the project's implementation
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a risk management plan, ensure compliance with international standards, and provide training on risk management and mitigation

gt_risks.description: Political and governance risk (Moderate), considering fragility, socio-political instability, violence and weak governance of beneficiary countries.
gt_risks.mitigation: Close engagement by the World Bank to coordinate activities with other key partners.

gt_risks.description: Technical design risk (Substantial), considering the complexities of coordinating national-level and regional-level activities to align and build on each other, and the different levels of readiness at country-level.
gt_risks.mitigation: Exploring the possibility of a coordinated implementation arrangement with CEMAC as the lead technical coordination body for regional activities.

gt_risks.description: Weak institutional capacity for implementation and sustainability (Substantial), combined with overstretched or nonexistent PIUs in respective countries.
gt_risks.mitigation: Strengthening the existing PIUs and intensive capacity building and targeted TA for newly established PIUs.

gt_risks.description: Fiduciary risk (Substantial) due to weak governance structures and inadequate FM systems.
gt_risks.mitigation: Close implementation support by the World Bank, including TA as well as additional training and coaching on fiduciary processes.

gt_risks.description: E&S risk (Substantial) given the security risks associated with service delivery in FCV (fragility, conflict, and violence) settings.
gt_risks.mitigation: Close implementation support by the World Bank, including TA as well as additional training and coaching on managing E&S risks.
